_about: Destination of every let-through recorded by scripts/issues.py. route: code / todo:<file> / human / check / ledger. gate: hard (must not happen), soft (report only), none (deliberate). A kind that is not here cannot be recorded: issues.record raises. See GAPS.md sections 3 and 4.

formula:diagnostic.about: Unrecognized formula commands or optional formula interpretation; does not block splitting.

drop:footnote.about: \footnote content is deleted (D1). Strategy undecided: keep as its own unit or drop. Size is the character count removed.

drop:float.about: a float (tabular/minipage/longtable/table/figure) is dropped wholesale (D2). tabular and minipage should keep their content.

drop:empty_sentence.about: A sentence with no alphanumeric content or placeholders was omitted.

conditional:iffalse.about: \iffalse takes its first branch, so commented-out draft returns to the text (D6).

conditional:unknown.about: An undecidable conditional is retained in full as a pending content block.

name:outside_vocabulary.about: a control word neither TeX nor the paper defines appears in the prose (R1). It belongs in the name question, which used to read only the formulas.

env:unknown.about: an environment that is in no class table and has no declaration (R3). See ENV-HANDLING.md.

check:C1.about: an orphan display whose previous sentence does not end with . ! ? : -- the lead-in sentence was cut (M1).

check:C2.about: a control word inside a sentence, outside a placeholder (M2).

check:C3.about: a bare { or } inside a sentence (M10).

check:C4.about: a sentence of at most two tokens with no terminal punctuation (D7).

check:C5.about: a sentence starting with a placeholder whose predecessor has no terminal punctuation.

check:C6.about: a formula's expanded text holds $ or \intertext (M7/M9).

check:C7.about: Unbalanced or misordered TeX grouping braces in inline or display math; escaped braces excluded.

check:C8.about: a section or title string holds $ (M6).

check:C9.about: a formula's expanded text holds four consecutive English words (M9: an unclosed $).

check:C10.about: a formula's expanded text holds \begin{..} other than grid/diagram (M9).

check:C11.about: a cases grid whose role is not piecewise (J3, a dead branch).

check:C12.about: a sentence holds REF\d+} or a ref target holds { (M5).

check:C13.about: a ref target that no label matches (D9).

check:C14.about: a name from outside_vocabulary appears in a sentence (R1).

human:source_error.about: the source itself is wrong: unbalanced $, a stray brace, a missing \input file.

human:model_refused.about: the model returned nothing twice for the same question, or answered 'unknown'.

human:label_style.about: a label whose numbering style cannot be rendered (R4).

parse:coverage.note: a sentence has no parse record

parse:failed.note: no derivation, FAILED tree, or log_prob is not a number

parse:leaf_mismatch.note: the tree's leaves are not the sentence's tokens

parse:root.note: root category is not one of S[dcl]/S[wq]/S[q]/S[qem]/NP

check:C16.note: a display whose body reads like prose (3+ consecutive English words)

name:defined_unexpanded.note: a name the paper defines that stayed unexpanded: asked with its definition instead of being dropped

display:orphan.note: a display whose anchor sentence was dropped

unresolved:line.note: one line latex2nl wrote to unresolved.log

check:linkage.about: Duplicate IDs, missing or inconsistent placeholder links, or unreachable records.

check:tokens.about: Token stream does not preserve every non-whitespace sentence character.

check:artifact.about: Required artifact or ledger is missing, malformed, or has an unregistered kind.

check:pending.about: Content or decisions remain unprocessed; strict mode returns 3.

sentence:brace_unwrapped.note: one half of a brace pair left in a sentence was stripped
